name: Stephen Talkhouse
description: A small, long-running music club and bar on Amagansett's Main Street. It books famous touring acts as well as local East End bands, often playing late into the night.

dancing.notes: Many shows have tables and seats, and the crowd is asked to stay quiet at listening shows. For dance-style shows (reggae, party and jam bands) the staff take the tables out so people can dance. The front room, where the bands play, is known for late-night dancing.

evidence.note: The club's FAQ says tables are removed for dance-oriented shows such as reggae so the crowd can dance; those shows use one general-admission price.
Travel guide says the front room is where the live music and dancing happen, with local bands most nights after 10 PM.
Visitor reviews include a 2019 review describing a late-night spot with good music and dancing.
